a_before_b.rationale: B focuses on high-level financial and infrastructure trade-offs between API and self-hosting, which can be understood without the system-level cost and latency calculation skills taught in A.

b_before_a.rationale: A involves calculating system-level cost and latency using compute cost, throughput, and parallelism, which does not require first understanding the proprietary vs. self-hosting trade-offs covered in B.
